title: Simple Calculator Application
description: An application that performs basic arithmetic operations.

features.name: Addition
features.description: Allows users to add two or more numbers.

features.name: Subtraction
features.description: Allows users to subtract one number from another.

features.name: Multiplication
features.description: Allows users to multiply two or more numbers.

features.name: Division
features.description: Allows users to divide one number by another.

constraints: Must handle basic arithmetic operations only
target_users: General users who need basic calculation functionality
